Maya (partnerships): heads-up: marketplace joint-GTM dry run at 2pm PT. main goals: press embargo alignment, SI preview readiness, and landing page final hero. who can confirm assets + quote status?
Ethan (marketing): i'll take hero + press timeline. drafting a hero + fallback by 12:30pm. will post copy here. :memo:
Rae (product): staging link: staging.redwood.com/mkt-joint. missing partner integration svg and an example OCI deployment snippet. need both by noon or i swap to neutral diagram.
Omar (solutions): SI team needs sandbox creds + a short topology doc. can run a 20m technical preview tomorrow if creds arrive today. i'll assemble demo checklist.
Priya (legal): legal note: embargo clause needs exact UTC time. recommend: embargo Tue 17:00 UTC. any partner quotes must include signoff email.
Maya (partnerships): embargo set to Tue 17:00 UTC. partners: assets + signed quote by Mon 21:00 UTC or we proceed with fallback messaging.
Ethan (marketing): posted draft hero variants:
- Variant 1: "Deploy production-grade inference with our partners."
- Variant 2 (fallback): "Ship inference at scale with Redwood."
Which should we use if partner assets are late?
Priya (legal): prefer Variant 2 for fallback. Variant 1 might imply performance guarantees.
Rae (product): for the OCI snippet i'll accept a small `docker-compose` example or a k8s manifest excerpt. tiny code block is fine.
Omar (solutions): pinged partner PM for creds at 1766666700. they said theyill try to send by EOD.
ops-bot: created task RED-GTM-7744: "Marketplace joint GTM dry run" assigned to Maya/Ethan/Rae/Omar, due 2024-08-01 21:00 UTC. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-GTM-7744
Maya (partnerships): checklist copy: - Embargo Tue 17:00 UTC - Assets (SVG, topology) due Mon 21:00 UTC - Signed quote due Mon 21:00 UTC - Hero copy fallback: Ethan by 12:30pm - SI preview creds: partner -> Omar - Staging patch for missing logo: Rae -> will add placeholder by EOD
Ethan (marketing): drafting press runbook now, will include fallback messaging and embargo handling steps.
Rae (product): adding placeholder logo + neutral diagram to avoid mobile layout jump. deploying patch in 10m.
Omar (solutions): will prepare recorded demo if creds delayed. uploading runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/si/marketplace-gTM-runbook-v3.md
Maya (partnerships): good. reconvene at 2pm PT for dry run. escalate any blockers here before 13:30 PT. :bell:
Ethan (marketing): will post final hero and the PR blurb in-thread before 13:00.
Priya (legal): will review any quote posted here immediately. please @Priya when partner approves.
Maya (partnerships): thanks team. outcome: if all items green we proceed with embargoed press release; if not, fallback flow and postpone partner-specific quote.
